SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
            SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
        ),
        adjusted_date AS (
            SELECT
            day_of_week(query_date) AS day_of_week_value,
            CASE
            WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
            WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
            ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
            END AS business_date,
            query_date AS original_date
            FROM params
        ),
        query_data as (
            SELECT
                ic.business_date,
                ic.id_cppib_index,
                ic.id_cppib_security,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY ic.business_date, ic.id_cppib_index, ic.id_cppib_security
                    ORDER BY ic.feed_version DESC
                ) AS rn
            FROM market.cppib_index_constituent ic
            where CAST(ic.business_date AS DATE) BETWEEN (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '7' day
            AND (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '1' day
            AND (
                ic.id_cppib_index IN (
                'SP1500_GR_USD_0_0',
                'SP400_GR_USD_0_0',
                'SP500_GR_USD_0_0',
                'SP600_GR_USD_0_0',
                'SPTSE_GR_CAD_0_0',
                
                
                'NK225_PR_USD_0_0',
                'HSI_GR_USD_0_0',
                
                'IXNDX_GR_USD_0_0',
                'RU1000_GR_USD_0_0',
                'RU3000_GR_USD_0_0')
            )
        ),
        daily_counts AS (
            SELECT business_date, COUNT(*) AS record_count
            FROM query_data
            WHERE rn = 1
            GROUP BY business_date
        ),
        average_count AS (
            SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count
            FROM daily_counts
        )
        SELECT avg_count FROM average_count) T LIMIT 0

				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
				ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
				END AS business_date
		FROM params
	),
     account_mapping_query AS (
         SELECT
             date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,

        SELECT

        cast('CPPIBSEC_ID' as VARCHAR) AS instrument_id_type,
        NULL AS id_enterprise_holding,
        h.scd_holding_key_id AS id_source_holding,
        h.security_group_id AS instrument_sub_group_code,
         h.security_group_name AS instrument_sub_group_name,
         h.abor_security_type_id AS instrument_type_code,
         h.abor_security_type_name AS instrument_type_name,
         h.abor_security_name AS instrument_name_source,
         h.balance_nominal_number AS current_nominal,
        h.balance_nominal_number*h.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS current_nominal_pc,
         h.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency + h.next_coupon_portfolio_currency AS abacus_accrued_interest_pc,
         h.accrued_interest_quotation_currency + h.next_coupon_quotation_currency AS abacus_accrued_interest_qc,
         h.quotation_currency_code AS current_notional_currency,
         h.quotation_currency_code AS market_value_currency,
         h.clean_price AS current_clean_price,
         h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS clean_market_value,
         h.balance_book_value_quotation_currency AS book_value,
         h.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency AS cost_value,
         h.accrued_interest_quotation_currency AS current_accrued_amount,
         h.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
         h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS clean_market_value_pc,
         h.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency AS cost_value_pc,
         h.accrued_interest_end_of_period_portfolio_currency AS current_accrued_amount_pc,
         sec.abor_quote_factor AS quote_factor,
         sec.abor_quote_type AS quote_type_description,
         sec.abor_coupon_term_unit AS coupon_frequency_unit_source,
         sec.abor_coupon_term_length AS coupon_frequency_length_source,
         NULL AS next_coupon_date_source,
         '2025-06-12' as business_date,
         sec.abor_issue_currency AS quoted_currency_code
         from RankedSecurities sec
         left join reference.scd_party_issuer par
               on sec.abor_issuer_id = par.party_id and sec.business_date = par.business_date
          join holdings.scd_holdings_main h
               on h.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
 	     where sec.rn = 1
 	     and h.business_date = '2025-06-12'
         and h.security_group_id in ('MBS', 'SINKBOND', 'ABSFR')
         and h.abor_security_type_id in ('COMMBS', 'COMMBS FLT', 'CORPSINKF', 'GOVSINKF', 'ABSFR')
        and h.balance_nominal_number !=0
         ) as a
    left Join
         (select
          CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new,
          cusip,
          isin,
          issue_date ,
          bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange,
          bloomberg_unique_id,
          sedol,
          ticker,
          coupon_type ,
          maturity_date,  
          bloomberg_exchange,
          equity_exchange_code, 
          document_type,
          instrument_description,
          exchange_name, 
          mic, 
          float_spread,
          coupon_rate,
          mic_primary_exchange, 
          primary_listing_exchange, 
          cast(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id,
          country_code as mds_country_code,
          coupon_frequency_code,
          region_code,
          market_sector_description,
          callable_flag,
          putable_flag,
          convertible_flag,
          next_coupon_date,
          collateral_type,
          sinkable_flag,
          first_coupon_date,
          par_amount,
          junior_flag,
          senior_flag,
          cast(delete_date AS VARCHAR) as delete_date,
          next_call_date,
          issue_price
          from asset.asset_bonds
          where business_date = date'2025-06-12'
         ) as b
     on a.id_instrument_new=b.cppib_sec_id_new
    left join
         (select
          CAST(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new3,
          party_name, 
          bloomberg_company_id, 
          domicile_country_code,
          incorp_country_code
          from party.party
          where business_date = date'2025-06-12'
         ) as d
     on b.cppib_party_id=d.cppib_party_id_new3
    left join
         (select
          CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new3,
          cppib_country_of_exposure_code ,
          cppib_currency_code ,
          cppib_currency_of_exposure_code
          -- cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
          -- cppib_sector_classification_name_2,
          -- cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
          -- cppib_sector_classification_name_4
          from asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications
          where business_date = date'2025-06-12'
         ) as e
     on b.cppib_sec_id_new=e.cppib_sec_id_new3
    left join
         (select
          country_code,
          country_name
          from reference.reference_country_codes 
          where business_date = date'2025-06-12'
         ) as f
     on e.cppib_country_of_exposure_code=f.country_code
    left join
         (select
          currency_code,
          currency_name
          from reference.reference_currency_codes
          where business_date = date'2025-06-12'
         ) as g
     on e.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code=g.currency_code
    left join
         (select
          id_model_portfolio,
          country_region_code,
          country_region_name,
          canada_foreign_emerging_name,
          funding_bucket_name,
          property_mortgage_reporting_name,
          program_name,
          unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
          from finance_accounting.model_portfolios
          where business_date = date'2025-06-12'
         ) as h
     on a.id_model_portfolio=h.id_model_portfolio
     left join 
          (select
          business_date,
          rating_Value,
          cppib_party_id
          from risk_prod.cppib_party_rating
          where cast(business_date as date) = date'2025-06-12'
          and rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
          ) as r
     on cast(r.cppib_party_id as varchar)= cast(b.cppib_party_id as varchar)
     left join
          (select
           CAST(cppib_party_id AS int) as party_cppib_party_id,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_2,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_4,
           cppib_country_of_exposure_code as party_cppib_country_of_exposure_code
          from party.party_enterprise_classification
          where business_date = date'2025-06-12'
          )  as pr
     on pr.party_cppib_party_id = cast(b.cppib_party_id AS int)
